title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into data used by the Credit Card Data Found dashboard. When another user with access to this dashboard selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the dashboard does not validate source and destination values before using them in drilldown searches, potentially exposing sensitive data accessible to the selecting user.
